### Summary

It seems that the modules which use httpapi are unable to decrypt ansible-vault encrypted variables. If I provider the api credentials as clear text variables the modules works fine. But they raise an exception if the variables are encrypted.

There are some other similar issues but I think they are in the wrong projects:

- https://github.com/ansible-collections/cisco.ios/issues/985
- https://github.com/ansible/awx/issues/14689
- https://github.com/ansible-collections/community.zabbix/issues/1146



### Issue Type

Bug Report

### Component Name

ansible-vault


### OS / Environment

Debian 12 with ansible via pipx

### Steps to Reproduce

<!--- Paste example playbooks or commands between quotes below -->
```yaml (paste below)
- name: Ensure proxy definition is up-to-date (added/updated/removed)
  vars:
    ansible_user: "{{ zabbix_proxy_api_login_user }}"
    # zabbix_proxy_api_key encrypted with ansible-vault
    ansible_zabbix_auth_key: "{{ zabbix_proxy_api_key }}"
    ansible_network_os: community.zabbix.zabbix
    ansible_connection: httpapi
    ansible_httpapi_use_ssl: true
    ansible_httpapi_port: 443
  community.zabbix.zabbix_proxy:
    state: "{{ zabbix_proxy_state }}"
    status: "{{ zabbix_proxy_status }}"
    proxy_name: "{{ zabbix_proxy_name }}"
    interface: "{{ zabbix_proxy_interface }}"
  delegate_to: "{{ zabbix_proxy_api_server_host }}"
```


### Expected Results

community.zabbix.zabbix_proxy should create the proxy configuration via API in Zabbix server
